oneSentenceStory: Ryan discovers and claims an instant reward using available points before they expire, instantly re-engaging with the program.
customerSituation: Ryan has 3,600 coins with 1,500 points expiring in 7 days after 41 days of inactivity.
storyTension: Risk of losing expiring points without realizing value due to recent notification fatigue and inactivity.
customerResolution: Surfacing a clear, low-friction instant redemption option allowing immediate reward claim.
primaryOutcome: Claim an instant reward using available points to re-engage with the rewards program.
